title: Pregnant college student injured after falling from moving bus in Thrissur
content: Chavakkad: A 21-year-old college student, who is three months pregnant, was injured after falling from the open rear door of a moving private bus on Thekke Bypass Road in Chavakkad, Thrissur, on Wednesday morning. The student, identified as Fathima of Little Flower College, Mammiyoor, had boarded the Palayur-bound bus from Chavakkad bus stand. The bus was operating on the Chavakkad-Kunnamkulam route. The incident occurred as the bus was passing through Thekke Bypass Road. CCTV footage shows Fathima falling through the open rear door and rolling onto the road. She was immediately taken to hospital for treatment.
